sentences.text:
In The Supreme Court Of India
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Civil Appeal No.2452/2024
 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (C) No.30431/2018)
 The State Of Haryana & Ors. Ap
 Versus
 Nafe Singh & Ors. Respo
 O R D E R
1.
Leave granted.

2. The impugned order dated 27-10-2016 passed by the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at
Chandigarh, whereby the Civil Writ Petition No.25824 of 2014 filed by the respondents  herein
was allowed, is under challenge before this Court.

3. Having heard the learned counsel for the appellants and the learned counsel for the respondents at length and after carefully perusing the material placed on record, it appears that the High Court had declared the acquisition proceedings in question as lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

entities.text:

2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, it is not disputed by the learned counsels for the parties that in view vs. Manoharlal And Ors. Etc.

Reported in (2020) 8 SCC (129), Reason:
the matter is required to be remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration.

4. In view of the above, the impugned order passed by the High Court is set aside and the matter is remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration in the light of the Judgment in the case of Indore Development Authority (supra).
5. It is clarified that all contentions are kept open to be raised by both the parties as may be legally permissible.
6. The appeal stands allowed in above terms.

This matter was called on for hearing today.
CORAM :

HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE BELA M. TRIVEDI HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PANKAJ MITHAL For Petitioner(s) Dr. Monika Gusain, AOR For Respondent(s) Mr. Dhiraj Abraham Philip, AOR Mr. Robin Ratnakar David, Adv. Mr. Febin Mathew Varghese,
Adv. Ms. Srishti Agrawaal, Adv.
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R 1.
Application seeking exemption from filing certified copy of the impugned order is allowed.
2. Leave granted.
3. The appeal stands allowed, in terms of the signed order.

(VISHAL ANAND) (MAMTA RAWAT)
